Case study 01 · Experiential

RCA RECORDS

× kwn & Victoria Monét · Atlanta activations during two artist press runs

The challenge

A press run gets an artist on air but rarely in front of the people who make a city care. RCA needed Atlanta moments that felt local and earned, inside a tight schedule.

What we did

  • Matched each artist to the community that fit their story.
  • kwn: an intimate meet and greet built for real fans.
  • Victoria Monét: a meet and greet plus a dance session with an Atlanta HBCU dance team.
  • Planned and ran both end to end within RCA’s press window.

Activations · Event Curation · Creative Direction

Results

2 FOR 2

Both activations went viral

PRESS

Picked up by The Shade Room and other digital outlets

SHARED

Posted by kwn and Victoria Monét on their own channels

04

Case study 02 · Social & strategy

IKE OGBAA

A content system for one author with two books and two very different audiences

The challenge

The Triangle of Leadership speaks to executives; Follow Zuri speaks to parents and educators. Strong footage, no system, no launch date, and later a new job that limited how public he could be.

What we did

  • Split platforms by behavior: one shared Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube profile; one TikTok per book.
  • Created Leadership Gems, a weekly series cut three ways.
  • Built a 3x weekly calendar from his existing footage, with his approval on every post.
  • Rebuilt the plan when his new role changed what he could post.

Think Tank · Social · Content Calendar

Results · 2 months

8.3K

Profile views, up from 100

6×

Followers, from 10 to 60

$0

Ad spend. All growth was organic.

Case study 03 · Brand & paid media

HAUS OF KAIRO

Repositioning a movement brand around wellness, then putting the new look to work

BLOOM collection / Meta ads

The challenge

Haus of Kairo believes movement is how people grow and show up for themselves. Its language was still selling workouts.

What we did

  • Set the direction as minimal luxury, with movement framed as self-care.
  • Built the voice around “Move with purpose” and #MoveWithKairo.
  • Directed a personal brand shoot for founder Kai Hardiman.
  • Put the assets to work across Meta ads, social, graphics, and the website.

Positioning · Creative Direction · Meta Ads · Styling

Results

1 SYSTEM

One voice and look across ads, social, web, and print

IN-HOUSE

Every Meta ad ran on creative from our own shoots

$80

Cost per purchase on Meta, early-stage e-commerce

06

Case study 04 · Creative direction & editorial

ROLLING OUT

The Vanity Report and The Style Thesis · Creative direction and editorial content lead

The challenge

Rolling Out had the audience and the authority in beauty and fashion, but no creative or editorial point of view tying the content together, and nothing to sell partnerships against.

What we did

  • Set the creative direction and editorial voice for two branded titles, each with its own visual system.
  • Led content development for three original series: Black Fashion Archive, Who Designed That, and City to City.
  • Commissioned for cover creative and talent booking, including Kandi and Pour Minds.
  • Wrote the editorial bibles and scripts, then built the partnership tiers to sell them.

Creative Direction · Editorial Lead · Talent Booking

Results

2.3M

Impressions on the Pour Minds shoot, plus tour publicity

20+

Episodes produced across both platforms

100+

Pitches to brands, influencers, and a top global agency

Services · What we offer, with work behind each one

STRATEGY & CREATIVE

THINK TANK

A planning retainer. Month one delivers a 1, 3, and 6-month plan; after that, we execute and adjust it.

Example

Ike Ogbaa: a full plan of action, rebuilt mid-campaign around a new job.

CREATIVE DIRECTION

The visual world and point of view for shoots, launches, campaigns, and artist rollouts.

Pour Minds for Rolling Out: 2.3M impressions.

COMMERCIAL CONTENT

Treatments in development for upcoming releases. Available to view on request.
